notes: Event date: June 1944 (Holm), dated 1 June 1944. Event definition: the battalion was at Amiens in June 1944; the claim is dated on the first day of the month. Event support: one source family (Holm, ww2.dk). Location: Amiens, Somme (place PL0743) with a precision of 5 km. Location support: Holm names Amiens. Review: confidence 0.3 from the rubric (G-b/L7: month-only date (0.3)); added in the Luftwaffe ground G-b pass (branch normandy-lw-ground-b, 19 November 2026): old value none, new value this claim; parent_unit_id old value none, new value blank, reason: parents are left blank on claim rows (the chain is in the command relations). Context: Inferred: old value none, new value 1 June 1944, reason: Holm gives only the month (June 1944). The claim is dated on the first day of the month, not the last, because the regiment went on to Normandy in June 1944 (Holm, Flak-Sturm-Regiment page; area only), so the end of the month is not covered. Holm's 1 June 1944 row has the battalion under 18. Flak-Brigade (regiment staff 87), no place; German Wikipedia (R004) lists "Flak-Abteilung 141" under Stab Flak-Regiment 79 on 6 June 1944.
